text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"\"Bachelor's degree\" vs \"Doctoral degree\"","dimension":"academic pedigree","description":"This captures the level and prestige of formal education brought to the role.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"5 years at Amazon\" vs \"3 years at Wayfair\"","dimension":"relevant experience depth","description":"This captures how much directly relevant professional experience the letter claims.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"designed agentic systems from scratch\" in both, plus \"built automation around vulnerability handling\"","dimension":"security automation specificity","description":"This captures how directly the letter speaks to automating vulnerability intake, triage, and related security workflows.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I write a great deal of Python\"","dimension":"Python emphasis","description":"This captures explicit foregrounding of Python as a major part of the applicant's skill set for the role.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"Foundational teams appeal to me\" vs \"Foundational teams appeal to me\" plus added \"automate and analysis layers\"","dimension":"security engineering alignment","description":"This captures how strongly the letter connects the applicant's experience to the team’s security-infrastructure mission rather than general backend work.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"When our stack exposes bugs in open-source dependencies, I write and submit the patches upstream\"","dimension":"open-source remediation orientation","description":"This captures willingness to engage in upstream patching and ecosystem-level bug fixing.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I have replaced ad-hoc traversals with proper graph algorithms\" vs same plus \"3 years of experience with data structures and algorithms\" implied by doctoral profile","dimension":"algorithmic grounding","description":"This captures evidence of practical comfort with data structures and algorithms beyond a brief mention.","winner":"A"}]}
